CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFSLIDER

CFSLIDER was a Java applet slider bar. KoldFusion renders it as a small gray panel holding a drop-down list of the allowed values from the range, stepping by SCALE, which submits exactly what the slider did: one number. It must be used inside CFFORM.

Category

Forms

Syntax

<CFSLIDER NAME="name"
    LABEL="text"
    RANGE="min_value,max_value"
    SCALE="increment"
    VALUE="integer"
    BGCOLOR="color"
    REFRESHLABEL="Yes/No"
    IMG="filename"
    IMGSTYLE="style"
    GROOVECOLOR="color"
    TEXTCOLOR="color"
    FONT="font_name"
    FONTSIZE="integer"
    ITALIC="Yes/No"
    BOLD="Yes/No"
    HEIGHT="pixels"
    WIDTH="pixels"
    VSPACE="pixels"
    HSPACE="pixels"
    ALIGN="alignment"
    ONVALIDATE="javascript_function"
    MESSAGE="text"
    ONERROR="javascript_function"
    NOTSUPPORTED="text">

Attributes

NAME
Required. Name of the form field.
LABEL
Optional. Text shown before the value list.
RANGE
Optional, default "0,100". Lowest and highest value, as "min,max".
SCALE
Optional, default "1". Step between values.
VALUE
Optional. Initial value. Defaults to the minimum.
BGCOLOR
Optional, default "#C0C0C0". Background color of the panel.
REFRESHLABEL
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it. A %value% placeholder in LABEL is replaced with the initial value.
IMG
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
IMGSTYLE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
GROOVECOLOR
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
TEXTCOLOR
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
FONT
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
FONTSIZE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
ITALIC
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
BOLD
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
HEIGHT
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
WIDTH
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
VSPACE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
HSPACE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
ALIGN
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
ONVALIDATE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it (every listed value is valid).
MESSAGE
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
ONERROR
Optional. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion ignores it.
NOTSUPPORTED
Optional. Text for browsers without Java. No longer needed; KoldFusion ignores it.

Usage

The value list is limited to 500 entries: if (max - min) / SCALE is larger, KoldFusion shows a small text box instead, and the user types the number. The range is shown in italics after the control.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFIF IsDefined("Form.Volume")>
  <CFOUTPUT><P>Volume set to <B>#Form.Volume#</B>,
  modem speaker at <B>#Form.Speaker#</B>%.</CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>

<CFFORM NAME="Mixer" ACTION="cfslider.cfm">
<TABLE CELLPADDING=4>
<TR><TD><CFSLIDER NAME="Volume" LABEL="Volume" RANGE="0,11" VALUE="7"></TD></TR>
<TR><TD><CFSLIDER NAME="Speaker" LABEL="Modem speaker" RANGE="0,100" SCALE="25"
    VALUE="100" BGCOLOR="##99CC99"></TD></TR>
</TABLE>
<INPUT TYPE="Submit" VALUE="Apply">
</CFFORM>
